identity: A Dimir control deck that answers everything and wins late off a graveyard engine. Vohar, Vodalian Desecrator is the named payoff and is genuinely two cards in one: '{T}: Draw a card, then discard a card' converts flooded lands into selection while filling the graveyard, and '{2}, Sacrifice Vohar: You may cast target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard this turn' rebuys the best answer already spent. Around it sits the deepest removal suite these colours offer in this cube - Cut Down answers 87 of the cube's 157 unique creature cards, Extinguish the Light is unconditional, and a kicked Rona's Vortex bottoms any creature regardless of size or ward. The Phasing of Zhalfir is modal via read ahead: started at chapter I it permanently removes any nonland permanent, started at chapter III it is a four-mana 'Destroy all creatures'. That one card is why this build concedes only a single coverage class - the graveyard, which no deck in this cube can answer. The manabase runs three off-colour common duals purely for their land types, putting all five basic land types in a two-colour deck. This build is CONTROL, not tempo: every Dimir dual in this cube enters tapped, so the colours cannot support the curve the archetype's name suggests, and the deck plays to that fact rather than against it.

mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {2}{B} (You may pay an additional {2}{B} as you cast this spell.)
Return target creature or planeswalker you don't control to its owner's hand. If this spell was kicked, put that permanent on the bottom of its owner's library instead.

mainboard.name: Vohar, Vodalian Desecrator
mainboard.oracle_text:
{T}: Draw a card, then discard a card. If you discarded an instant or sorcery card this way, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
{2}, Sacrifice Vohar: You may cast target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard this turn. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead. Activate only as a sorcery.

mainboard.oracle_text:
Read ahead (Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add one after your draw step. Skipped chapters don't trigger. Sacrifice after III.)

III — Destroy all creatures. For each creature destroyed this way, its controller creates a 2/2 black Phyrexian creature token.

mainboard.oracle_text:
Read ahead (Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add one after your draw step. Skipped chapters don't trigger. Sacrifice after III.)
I — You may cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value 1 or 2 from your hand without paying its mana cost.
II — Target player mills four cards.
III — Exile target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. Copy it. You may cast the copy.

sideboard.name: Negate
sideboard.when_to_board: vs. the cube's 6 sweepers (all noncreature spells) and its 33 artifacts and enchantments, which this deck can only answer on the stack

sideboard.name: Choking Miasma
sideboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {G} (You may pay an additional {G} as you cast this spell.)
If this spell was kicked, put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
All creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs. token and go-wide decks only - 'All creatures get -2/-2' also kills 7 of this deck's own 12 creature copies, so it comes in only when that trade is correct

sideboard.name: Essence Scatter
sideboard.when_to_board: vs. creature decks whose threats outclass the removal suite, especially anything with ward

sideboard.name: Impulse
sideboard.oracle_text: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs. grindy matchups - the maindeck runs 0 cantrips, so this is the selection the control plan otherwise lacks

sideboard.name: Pilfer
sideboard.oracle_text: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs. decks holding a specific answer or threat this deck cannot beat on board; reroled from combo hate after the dossier showed no combo class

sideboard.oracle_text:

sideboard.when_to_board: vs. grindy control matchups - with 10 instants and sorceries its discount makes it a 5/5 ward 2 for two or three mana by turn eight

identity_es: Un control Dimir que responde a todo y gana tarde con un motor de cementerio. Vohar, Vodalian Desecrator es la recompensa nombrada y es genuinamente dos cartas en una: '{T}: Draw a card, then discard a card' convierte las tierras sobrantes en selección mientras llena el cementerio, y '{2}, Sacrifice Vohar: You may cast target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard this turn' recompra la mejor respuesta ya gastada. A su alrededor se sienta el paquete de eliminación más profundo que ofrecen estos colores en este cubo: Cut Down responde a 87 de las 157 cartas de criatura únicas del cubo, Extinguish the Light es incondicional, y un Rona's Vortex kickeado manda al fondo cualquier criatura sin importar tamaño ni ward. The Phasing of Zhalfir es modal gracias a leer por adelantado: empezada en el capítulo I retira permanentemente cualquier permanente que no sea tierra, empezada en el capítulo III es un 'Destroy all creatures' de cuatro manás. Esa única carta es por lo que esta construcción concede una sola clase de cobertura: el cementerio, que ningún mazo de este cubo puede responder. La base de maná juega tres duales comunes fuera de color puramente por sus tipos de tierra, poniendo los cinco tipos de tierra básica en un mazo bicolor. Esta construcción es CONTROL, no tempo: cada dual Dimir de este cubo entra girada, así que los colores no pueden sostener la curva que sugiere el nombre del arquetipo, y el mazo juega con ese hecho en lugar de contra él.
